# bintables/bxor

> ^ : `xor`.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/bxor.pkg) · translates [std/bxor](../std/bxor.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
xor rax, {right.operand}
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
xor rax, rbx
```
